subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this branch be consolidated into existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description guidance, or should OpenClaw intentionally change nested sub-agent policy?
rationale: Current main already has several sessions_spawn guidance surfaces and supports configured nested spawning, so the right outcome depends on maintainer prompt-policy intent rather than a mechanical patch.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep useful examples only if they fit the current availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, child prompts, docs, and tests together instead of changing this prompt text alone.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: If the shipped current-main guidance is enough, avoid merging another model-facing policy surface from this stale branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep useful examples only if they fit the current availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision turns on nested sub-agent semantics introduced by the nested orchestration work.
